summary.text: Josh Cole is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 65, which covers parts of Spotsylvania and Stafford counties and the City of Fredericksburg.
Josh Cole has been a member since 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Josh Cole was born in Washington, D.C., in 1990.
Josh Cole studied at the University of Mary Washington (BLS, Religious Studies).
Josh Cole's listed occupation is clergy.

Josh Cole's listed memberships and affiliations include the Union of Charismatic Orthodox Churches, the Stafford NAACP (former president), the Fredericksburg Area Interfaith Committee, the Stafford County Democratic Committee, the Democratic Party of Virginia 7th Congressional District Committee, the FAHASS board, Stafford Rotary, and the Big Brother Big Sister Greater Fredericksburg board.
The profile lists Tiffany R. Santora-Cole as Josh Cole's spouse.

The House profile lists Josh Cole's committee assignments as Privileges and Elections, General Laws, and Health and Human Services, and Josh Cole chairs the Voting Rights subcommittee of Privileges and Elections.
